teaser.en: Sticks from this shrub catch octopus on the reef, but burn it at home and, it is said, you risk leprosy.
teaser.sw: Vijiti vya kichaka hiki hutumika kukamata pweza kwenye miamba ya matumbawe, lakini ukikichoma nyumbani, inasemekana unajiweka hatarini kupata ukoma.

summary.en: *Mvua pweza*, the 'octopus fisher', is a coastal bush shrub with yellow flowers and black fruits on a bright red base. Its sticks are used to catch octopus, but it must never be burned or built with.
summary.sw: *Mvua pweza*, yaani 'mvuvi wa pweza', ni kichaka cha porini cha pwani chenye maua ya manjano na matunda meusi yaliyokaa juu ya kitako chekundu angavu. Vijiti vyake hutumika kukamata pweza, lakini kamwe hakichomwi wala hakitumiki kujengea.

about.en: *Mvua pweza* is a shrub of the Ochna family, the plants often called Mickey Mouse bushes. Its flowers are yellow. After flowering, the sepals and the swollen base of the flower turn bright red, and the black fruits sit on top like eyes, a striking red-and-black display.
about.sw: *Mvua pweza* ni kichaka cha familia ya Ochna, mimea inayojulikana mara nyingi kwa Kiingereza kama *Mickey Mouse bushes*. Maua yake ni ya manjano. Baada ya kuchanua, sepali na kitako kilichovimba cha ua hugeuka rangi nyekundu angavu, na matunda meusi hukaa juu yake kama macho, mandhari ya kuvutia ya rangi nyekundu na nyeusi.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland, close enough to the shore for its sticks to be carried down to the reef.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka ya pwani, karibu vya kutosha na ufukwe kiasi kwamba vijiti vyake vinaweza kubebwa hadi kwenye miamba ya matumbawe.

uses.en: Its sticks are used to catch octopus on the reef.
uses.sw: Vijiti vyake hutumika kukamata pweza kwenye miamba ya matumbawe.

culture.en: Its two names point in opposite directions. *Mvua pweza* means 'octopus fisher', after its use at sea. *Mtsonga mahana* means 'causer of leprosy': using it for firewood or for building is believed to cause leprosy, so it is kept out of the home.
culture.sw: Majina yake mawili yanaelekeza pande mbili zinazopingana. *Mvua pweza* lina maana ya 'mvuvi wa pweza', kutokana na matumizi yake baharini. *Mtsonga mahana* lina maana ya 'msababishaji wa ukoma': kukitumia kama kuni au kwa ujenzi huaminika kusababisha ukoma, kwa hiyo huwekwa mbali na nyumbani.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mvua pweza* and *mtsonga mahana*. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Ochna thomasiana*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mvua pweza* na *mtsonga mahana*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea hukiita *Ochna thomasiana*.
